journey.title: Apply
journey.text: Create your desk account with your name, Safaricom phone number, ID number, and your county, constituency and ward. Have an agent code or an invite code? Add it to join that team.

journey.title: Verify
journey.text: Upload your ID (front and back) and a selfie, and set the payout account where you are paid.

journey.title: Train
journey.text: Samuhia reviews your application and invites you to training and certification. Every application needs approval, whoever invited you.

journey.title: Activate
journey.text: Once approved, Samuhia activates your desk with your own desk code.

journey.title: Serve
journey.text: A customer asks for help and reads you a one-time code. You do the work in the app.

journey.title: Get paid
journey.text: When the customer pays, Paystack splits the money and your share goes to your payout account. Team and incentive earnings are added up and paid automatically each month.

rules: This is an independent, commission-based role. It is not employment, and there is no salary or guaranteed income.
You open a customer's account only when they ask for help and give you their one-time code.
You may not own, administer or be related to the accounts you serve.
Samuhia sets the prices. You charge only what the app shows and take no payment outside it.
Commission is earned only when a customer actually pays. Free plans, free trials and free sign-up SMS tokens earn nothing.
Refunds are handled by Paystack and appear as reversals in your earnings.
Customer information stays private. Samuhia may suspend or close a desk that breaks the rules.
One person, one desk: your ID number, phone number and email can belong to only one desk, and phone numbers must be Safaricom.
Places in each ward and constituency are limited, and ranks are set by Samuhia after review.
Team and incentive earnings follow your desk agreement. They can be adjusted or withheld when customers are refunded or the rules are broken.
Estimates on this site assume a {{feePct}}% payment fee. The actual fee is set by Paystack, and prices can change.

faq.q: Is Samuhia Desk a job with a salary?
faq.a: No. Desk agents are independent and earn commission and service income. There is no salary and no guaranteed minimum, so what you earn depends on the customers you serve.

faq.q: How much can a desk agent earn?
faq.a: It depends on how many customers you support. A completed Excel import earns about {{importNet}}, and a paid MyChama plan earns from {{chamaMinClerk}} to {{chamaMaxSenior}} per chama per month. Illustrative months are on this page, and they are estimates, not promises.

faq.q: When and how am I paid?
faq.a: Service charges and commissions are split automatically by Paystack at the moment the customer pays, after payment fees, and sent to your payout account. Milestone and support bonuses are reviewed and paid by Samuhia.

faq.q: What is the difference between Clerk, Senior and Lead?
faq.a: Every new desk starts as a Clerk and earns {{clerkPct}}% of subscriptions. Seniors and Leads earn {{seniorPct}}%, and add a team share as they build a team. Samuhia sets the rank after review, places are limited in each ward and constituency, and there is no automatic promotion or fixed timeline.

faq.q: What do I need to apply?
faq.a: Your name, phone number, ID number, ward, a photo of your ID (front and back), a selfie and a payout account. Samuhia reviews every application and trains approved desks before activation.

faq.q: Do I pay anything to join?
faq.a: The application flow in the app does not ask for a joining payment. Be cautious of anyone who asks you to pay outside the app, and report it to info@samuhia.co.ke.

faq.q: Can I work on more than one path?
faq.a: Yes. The paths describe where you focus, not separate accounts. One desk can support chamas, schools and landlords with the same app.

faq.q: Can I build a team?
faq.a: Yes. Seniors and Leads can invite new agents, and new agents can join with a team's agent code. Every application still needs Samuhia's approval, whoever invited the applicant.

faq.q: What is a County Admin desk?
faq.a: County Admin desks are appointed by Samuhia under a separate agreement. They help train and approve agents in their county. There is no public application for this role.

faq.q: Do I need a Safaricom number?
faq.a: Yes. Desk accounts use a Safaricom phone number, and each person can have only one desk, checked by ID number and phone number.

faq.q: Do I need experience to be a Desk Clerk?
faq.a: No formal qualification is listed. You need a valid ID, a phone, a payout account and a willingness to complete Samuhia's training.

faq.q: How much does a Clerk earn per chama?
faq.a: On MyChama plans, a Clerk earns from {{chamaMinClerk}} per chama per month on the Starter plan, rising with the chama's plan.

paths.headline: Grow into a Senior Desk.

forWho: Clerks with a growing base of paying chamas and landlords
Desks whose customers stay subscribed month after month
Agents with a record of confirmed, quality support
youDo: Everything a Clerk does, with a higher commission share

paths.callout: On the same account, a Senior earns {{seniorPct}}% where a Clerk earns {{clerkPct}}%, a difference of 5 percentage points on every paid subscription. Seniors can also invite Clerks to their team.

faq.q: How do I become a Senior Desk?
faq.a: Samuhia's top desk reviews desks and sets the rank. Keeping customers paying and well supported is what makes a desk worth reviewing. No promotion date is promised.

faq.q: Does a Senior earn more on desk services?
faq.a: No. Desk services pay {{keepPct}}% to every rank. The higher share applies to subscriptions and reports.

faq.q: Can a Senior Desk invite other agents?
faq.a: Yes. Seniors can invite new Clerks to join their team, and Clerks who use a Senior's code join that team. Every application still needs Samuhia's approval.

paths.headline: Lead a team as a Lead Desk.
paths.lead: Leads earn {{leadPct}}% on their own customers and a team share on the paying, retained customers of the Seniors and Clerks in their team. Places are limited in each constituency, and rank is set by Samuhia after review.
forWho: Seniors with a strong, retained customer base
Community organisers and business owners who can coach newer agents
Agents who want to build a team, not just a customer list
youDo: Everything a Senior does

Invite new agents to your team. Every invite still needs Samuhia approval
Keep your team's customers paying and well supported
paths.callout: On the accounts you serve yourself, a Lead earns the same {{leadPct}}% as a Senior. Team earnings depend on your team's paying, retained customers and are paid automatically each month.

faq.q: How do I become a Lead Desk?
faq.a: Samuhia reviews Senior desks and sets the rank. Places are limited in each constituency, so there is no automatic promotion and no fixed timeline.

faq.q: Can I earn from my team?
faq.a: Yes. Leads earn a team share on the paying, retained customers of the Seniors and Clerks in their team. It is added by Samuhia, so it does not reduce your team's pay. Terms are shared when you are approved.

paths.callout: MyChama is free for groups up to 6 members. Commission starts when a chama subscribes to a paid plan.

faq.q: Do I earn while a chama is on the Free plan?
faq.a: No. Commission is earned on paid plans, SMS purchases and paid reports. Desk services you perform for the chama are paid by the chama.

faq.q: Do I earn every month from the same chama?
faq.a: You earn on each paid subscription charge for as long as the chama stays on a paid plan with you as its desk. Samuhia cannot promise that a chama will renew.

paths.callout: On a school's first top-up under {{firstThreshold}}, a desk earns the full margin. For example a {{firstTopUp}} top-up earns about {{firstTopUpShare}}. Free sign-up tokens never earn.

faq.q: How does a School Desk earn if MyRegister is free?
faq.a: Through desk services, such as imports and manual entry that schools pay for, and through a share of the margin on SMS credits schools buy.

faq.q: Do free SMS tokens earn commission?
faq.a: No. Free sign-up tokens never earn commission. Commission applies only to SMS credits a school pays for.

faq.q: How much do I earn on rent collection?
faq.a: Up to {{rentMax}} per rent payment, which is {{rentDeskPct}}% of Samuhia's fee on the payment. That fee is capped at {{rentCap}}.
